narration:0:1421158001:0.text: With the guests all in place, Otivia's debut performance is about to begin...
narration:0:1421158001:0.source_cn: 嘉宾逐渐就位，而吟游诗人欧蒂薇的首演也即将开始……

say:2:1421158002:1.text: Ladies and gentlemen, I'm Otivia, the organizer and the sole performer of the show today.
say:2:1421158002:1.source_cn: 各位，我是欧蒂薇，今天演出的发起者，也是唯一的主演。

say:3:1421158003:1.text: Before we begin, please allow me to say a few words.
say:3:1421158003:1.source_cn: 但在正式开始前，请允许我多做两句说明。

say:4:1421158004:1.text: Not long ago, I felt lost and helpless over how little I had achieved.
say:4:1421158004:1.source_cn: 就在不久之前，我还因为一事无成而茫然无助。

say:5:1421158005:1.text: It was my friend, <style="highlight">Xera</style>, who pulled me out of my mansion and opened my eyes to the real world.

say:6:1421158006:1.text: She even introduced me to the great Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:6:1421158006:1.source_cn: 又为我引见了伟大的魔法师<style=stress><...
say:6:1421158006:1.male: She even introduced me to the great Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:6:1421158006:1.female: She even introduced me to the great Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>.

say:7:1421158007:1.text: Thanks to his advice, I found a new path forward—becoming a minstrel.
say:7:1421158007:1.male: Thanks to his advice, I found a new path forward—becoming a minstrel.
say:7:1421158007:1.female: Thanks to her advice, I found a new path forward—becoming a minstrel.

say:8:1421158008:1.text: I aspire to capture and share the stories of Sal'thorin through my songs and poetry, creating works that resonate with the people.
say:8:1421158008:1.source_cn: 我想要用自己的歌曲与诗句记录与传播萨洛克兰的故事，为萨...

say:9:1421158009:1.text: All of you here have given me tremendous support during the creation of my first work. I really appreciate it.
say:9:1421158009:1.source_cn: 今天邀请的诸位，也是在我的第一次创作中，给予了巨大帮助...

say:10:1421158010:1.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, would you play the music for me just this once?
say:10:1421158010:1.source_cn: 因此，仅限今天，我想拜托<style=stress><...
say:10:1421158010:1.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, would you play the music for me just this once?

choice_prompt:11:1421158010.source_cn: 因此，仅限今天，我想拜托<style=stress><player_name></style>大人，为我伴奏。

say:12:1421158011:1.text: Everyone, please enjoy this heroic epic by the three of us!
say:12:1421158011:1.source_cn: 那么，现在开始。新人·欧蒂薇及魔法师梅林、席蕾共同创作...
say:12:1421158011:1.male: Everyone, please enjoy this heroic epic by the three of us!
say:12:1421158011:1.female: Everyone, please enjoy this heroic epic by the three of us!

say:13:1421158012:1.text: This poem depicts the great journey of Indris, the hero of Sal'thorin!
say:13:1421158012:1.source_cn: 击穿深渊之光——萨洛克兰伟大英雄因度厄的成长历程记录。
